title: OmniCleave geometric graph learning predicts protease-substrate specificity
summary: OmniCleave is a structure-aware geometric graph learning framework trained on 57,278 structure-informed protease-substrate pairs from 9,651 substrates across over 100 proteases in six families. It outperformed existing approaches on large-scale benchmarks. Experimental validation confirmed three previously unannotated caspase-3 substrates and 21 cleavage sites predicted by the model. Preprint; validation covers caspase-3 only.
